screen.rationale: Primary study; solvent-cast PMMA/modified-nanosilica films aged in a Q-Sun Xe-3 chamber simulating full sunlight (295-800 nm, passes E3) with Mn by GPC and MMA by Py-GC-MS, but Mn versus aging time appears only in Figures 8a/9a/10a and the degradation-degree heat map (Fig. 12), and MMA is reported only as specific peak area in figures (Figs. 8b-11); the text and Table 3 give only qualitative rank orders and arrows, so no endpoint value is available as text or table.

excluded_observations.why: Only in figures (Fig. 8b, 9b, 10b, 11); a relative peak area per mg, not a calibrated yield.
